newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading of China Light suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading of China Light suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of China Light and Power Co Ltd was suspended, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
The shares were suspended at the company's own request pending an annoucement, an exchange spokesman said.
China Light shares were last traded at HK$33.70 per share prior to the suspension, unchanged from their previous close on Tuesday.
China Light spokeswoman declined to comment but said the company will make an announcement as soon as possible.
